messages:
natalie: Quick noteI opened PR #4522 to fix inconsistencies in the API ref for POST /v1/ingest. The curl example shows `uid`, the OpenAPI schema uses `user_id`, and the Go SDK snippet still references `user`. Also `metadata` is documented as required but server accepts null/omitted. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4522

ryan: Repro on staging. We accept both `uid` and `user_id` today, but docs should present the canonical field: `user_id`.

vik: Agree. Suggestion: update all examples to `user_id`, add two example payloads (metadata object + metadata null), and include a tiny compatibility note showing `uid` -> `user_id` mapping.

natalie: Plan in PR: (1) canonicalize examples to `user_id`, (2) mark `metadata` as "nullable object" in schema, (3) include example variants:
```json
{ "user_id": "alice", "content": "Ping", "metadata": {"channel": "web"} }
```
and
```json
{ "user_id": "alice", "content": "Ping", "metadata": null }
```
(4) update curl, Node, Python, and Go snippets to reflect canonical fields, showing Go: `Metadata: nil` example.

ryan: Can we also add a short migration blurb under docs/migration/legacy-fields.md with exact mappings and dates? e.g., `uid -> user_id` (supported through 2026-06-30).

vik: I'll add a docs CI smoke test that parses code-block JSON across the API ref pages and asserts required example fields are present. That should prevent future drift.

natalie: Done in the PR: added docs/test_examples/test_ingest_examples.py and linked it in the description. Also added a follow-up issue to verify SDK generator picks up schema notes.

docs-bot: PR opened by natalie: #4522 "standardize ingest examples + nullable metadata + migration note". CI queued.

ryan: Nice. I'll do a quick review after CI passes. Two tiny nits: clarify language around "nullable" vs "optional" and add an explicit sentence "clients may omit `metadata` or send `null`."

natalie: Thanks, will update wording and ping @vik. Merge and backport to 1.x after approval. :shipit:
